verdict.rationale: Muse runs its own VM with a file system and terminal, and Meta's docs say everything Muse generates is stored there, where you can inspect, edit, and download it freely. That gives a real create-and-export path. The only artifact examples are trackers, study guides, and dashboards, and no document or slide formats are named. missing for 10: explicit document/presentation creation (e.g. docx/pptx/PDF), documented iterative editing of files via the assistant, named export formats, independent hands-on corroboration.
